results.title: A safer, more compassionate approach to severe hoarding
results.description: UNSW Professor Jessica Grisham is sharing practical strategies to help health professionals support people with severe hoarding who are not ready to engage in conventional treatment. For people experiencing severe hoarding, the prospect of having their possessions removed can prevent them from seeking help, even when their living conditions pose serious health and safety risks. … Continued
